description: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

name: Diggersby
description: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

name: Porygon2
description: For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.

name: Greedent
description: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Krabby
description: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.

name: Rattata
description: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

name: Raichu
description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

name: Scraggy
description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Durant
description: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Milotic
description: ______ has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Combee
description: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

name: Rhydon
description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Pawniard
description: ______ will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

name: Cyndaquil
description: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

name: Gliscor
description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Exploud
description: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.

name: Bidoof
description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Remoraid
description: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Poochyena
description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mismagius
description: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

name: Machop
description: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Happiny
description: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others' feet and cause them to stumble.

name: Spritzee
description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: Ninetales
description: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Ninetales
description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Alolan Vulpix
description: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Pancham
description: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: Buneary
description: ______ can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Probopass
description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Houndoom
description: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

name: Klinklang
description: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

name: Meowstic
description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Seedot
description: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Exeggutor
description: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Murkrow
description: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

name: Voltorb
description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Gliscor
description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Moltres
description: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: Meditite
description: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Entei
description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Cranidos
description: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.

name: Eevee
description: A rare and unique Pokémon about which little is known, as few have been captured.

name: Dewgong
description: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

name: Bunnelby
description: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.

name: Kricketune
description: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Prinplup
description: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Turtonator
description: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Wigglytuff
description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a Body Slam.

name: Leafeon
description: When you see ______ asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Gloom
description: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

name: Baxcalibur
description: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

name: Nidorino
description: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

name: Garchomp
description: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

name: Porygon
description: It was built 20 years ago by scientists who dreamed of exploring space. Their dreams have yet to come true.

name: Larvitar
description: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.

name: Amaura
description: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

name: Mew
description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe ______ to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Latios
description: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Noibat
description: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

name: Tangela
description: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

name: Wailmer
description: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Duskull
description: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Barraskewda
description: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

name: Raticate
description: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

name: Lillipup
description: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

name: Lunatone
description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Wooper
description: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

name: Chinchou
description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Sylveon
description: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.

name: Magearna
description: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

name: Scyther
description: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Lillipup
description: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

name: Nidorina
description: When feeding its young, it first chews the food into a paste, then spits it out for the offspring.

name: Voltorb
description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Crobat
description: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.

name: Plusle
description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Trubbish
description: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.

name: Gligar
description: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Magmar
description: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. ______ are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

name: Simipour
description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Meloetta
description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Flabébé
description: This ______ rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

name: Gligar
description: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

name: Poochyena
description: Poochyena's nose can identify any scent. It's very useful for reconnaissance.

name: Lapras
description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Rhydon
description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Smoliv
description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Makuhita
description: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

name: Flaaffy
description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

name: Druddigon
description: It runs through the narrow tunnels formed by Excadrill and Onix. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

name: Sudowoodo
description: It stands along paths pretending to be a tree. If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.

name: Venomoth
description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Drizzile
description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: Geodude
description: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

name: Magcargo
description: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Golett
description: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

name: Bibarel
description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Victini
description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with ______ always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Grimmsnarl
description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Jolteon
description: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

name: Shaymin
description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Gothorita
description: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Hitmonlee
description: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

name: Yanma
description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Inteleon
description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Lairon
description: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Heatran
description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Raichu
description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Omanyte
description: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

name: Avalugg
description: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back makes it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

name: Carnivine
description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Qwilfish
description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: Croagunk
description: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, ______ hits them with a poison jab.

name: Snorlax
description: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Gimmighoul
description: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Lunatone
description: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

name: Mankey
description: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

name: Bastiodon
description: It lived in the same environments as Rampardos. Their fossils have been found together—seemingly from after they'd fought to the finish.

name: Weezing
description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a ______.

name: Totodile
description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Drowzee
description: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

name: Cosmoem
description: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

name: Luxio
description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Carvanha
description: It won't attack while it's alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other ______ to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

name: Plusle
description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Vespiquen
description: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

name: Dark Dragonair
description: As is fitting for a legendary Pokémon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall.

name: Mr. Mime
description: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

name: Spiritomb
description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

name: Skitty
description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Smeargle
description: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

name: Phanpy
description: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won't be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Mareep
description: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Drakloak
description: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.

name: Krookodile
description: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

name: Musharna
description: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: Starmie
description: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when ______ is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Dunsparce
description: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

name: Swinub
description: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

name: Porygon
description: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

name: Scolipede
description: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

name: Machop
description: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

name: Dhelmise
description: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
description: Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon. Local people take pride in its appearance, saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

name: Mew
description: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

name: Dark Wartortle
description: A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often.

name: Ampharos
description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

name: Milcery
description: They say that any patisserie visited by ______ is guaranteed success and good fortune.

name: Kecleon
description: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

name: Aerodactyl
description: This vicious Pokémon is said to have flown in ancient skies while shrieking high-pitched cries.

name: Dewpider
description: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Nuzleaf
description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Eevee
description: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

name: Hoppip
description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when ______ gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Weepinbell
description: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Metapod
description: It prepares for evolution by hardening its shell as much as possible to protect its soft body.

name: Alolan Rattata
description: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.

name: Ninetales
description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Golem
description: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: Chansey
description: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

name: Gible
description: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Popplio
description: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Seviper
description: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

name: Starmie
description: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

name: Poliwrath
description: With extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

name: Rhydon
description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Fennekin
description: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Flygon
description: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

name: Banette
description: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

name: Vullaby
description: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

name: Arbok
description: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

name: Dusknoir
description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Dark Magcargo
description: The shell on its back comes off easily, exposing the flames running through its body.

name: Persian
description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Samurott
description: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

name: Alolan Dugtrio
description: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

name: Tyrogue
description: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Toxel
description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

name: Lotad
description: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

name: Lanturn
description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Mawile
description: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Roselia
description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the ______ is.

name: Ducklett
description: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Klinklang
description: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

name: Koffing
description: First discovered in a weapons factory, this Pokémon can now be found almost anywhere.

name: Chansey
description: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Clamperl
description: ______'s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.

name: Dragonair
description: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

name: Turtonator
description: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: Pangoro
description: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

name: Donphan
description: ______ is normally a calm Pokemon, but once it is enraged, it will curl its body into a ball and charge at you while rolling.

name: Unown
description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Sawk
description: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Salandit
description: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates ______'s poisonous gas.

name: Iron Jugulis
description: It's possible that ______, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

name: Smeargle
description: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

name: Oricorio
description: This ______ relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.

name: Muk
description: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Bellsprout
description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Chansey
description: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
description: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

name: Buneary
description: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

name: Torterra
description: Some Pokémon are born on a ______'s back and spend their entire life there.

name: Palossand
description: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. ______ eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

name: Stunfisk
description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Vulpix
description: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.

name: Carbink
description: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It's occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

name: Tarountula
description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Sliggoo
description: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells, rather than using ears or a nose.

name: Shiinotic
description: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

name: Lombre
description: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Chespin
description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Lickitung
description: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is…questionable.

name: Klinklang
description: The minigear spins at high speed. Then the energy from the red core charges the minigear to make it ready to fire.

name: Sceptile
description: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

name: Meganium
description: ______'s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

name: Zeraora
description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Seedot
description: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Weepinbell
description: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

name: Krookodile
description: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Vanillish
description: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

name: Diglett
description: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Samurott
description: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

name: Medicham
description: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

name: Cherubi
description: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

name: Golbat
description: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

name: Sylveon
description: When this Pokémon sights its prey, it swirls its ribbonlike feelers as a distraction. A moment later, it pounces.

name: Cloyster
description: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.

name: Chinchou
description: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

name: Talonflame
description: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from ______ wings.

name: Slakoth
description: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

name: Porygon-Z
description: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

name: Croagunk
description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Jigglypuff
description: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Zubat
description: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, ______ flies around with skill.

name: Dark Hypno
description: Carries a pendulum with it always. Sometimes appears near less-traveled roads and schools at dusk.

name: Dewpider
description: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

name: Vikavolt
description: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

name: Crabominable
description: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.

name: Quagsire
description: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

name: Alolan Muk
description: There are over a hundred kinds of poison inside its body. Chemical reactions between different poisons are the source of its vitality.

name: Hakamo-o
description: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, ______ attacks.

name: Sunkern
description: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a Spearow, it violently shakes its leaves.

name: Ferrothorn
description: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Snubbull
description: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Petilil
description: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.

name: Arcanine
description: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

name: Meowstic
description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Kabuto
description: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

name: Noibat
description: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Uxie
description: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

name: Scatterbug
description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Snubbull
description: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

name: Haunter
description: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

name: Finneon
description: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

name: Hisuian Electrode
description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Solosis
description: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

name: Gabite
description: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

name: Tympole
description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Floette
description: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

name: Frogadier
description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Fearow
description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land or rest.

name: Tyrogue
description: Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Gumshoos
description: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

name: Bronzong
description: Ancient people believed that petitioning ______ for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: Aipom
description: It lives high among the treetops. It can us its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

name: Bellsprout
description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Misdreavus
description: It loves to bite and yank people’s hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Sandslash
description: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

name: Taillow
description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Psyduck
description: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

name: Salandit
description: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates ______'s poisonous gas.

name: Raichu
description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Sentret
description: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

name: Dugtrio
description: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Toxapex
description: Those attacked by ______'s poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

name: Scraggy
description: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.

name: Murkrow
description: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

name: Seadra
description: Capable of swimming backward by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Rapidash
description: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Jynx
description: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Varoom
description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

name: Seismitoad
description: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

name: Excadrill
description: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of ______'s rampant digging.

name: Nosepass
description: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

name: Cottonee
description: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

name: Spearow
description: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

name: Snorlax
description: It stops eating only to sleep. It doesn't feel full unless it eats nearly 900 pounds a day.

name: Luvdisc
description: Loving couples have a soft spot for this Pokémon, so honeymoon hotels often release this Pokémon into their pools.

name: Omanyte
description: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.

name: Oricorio
description: This ______ has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.

name: Gossifleur
description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Magmortar
description: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

name: Muk
description: It immobilizes its opponents by wrapping them in its huge, poisonous body. It'll smoosh you, too!

name: Sableye
description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Growlithe
description: A Pokémon with a loyal nature, it will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

name: Gurdurr
description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Tapu Fini
description: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Steelix
description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Shellder
description: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

name: Hoopa
description: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Palafin
description: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen's, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

name: Gligar
description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Shellos
description: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

name: Diglett
description: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: Growlithe
description: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.

name: Manaphy
description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Jynx
description: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

name: Pikachu
description: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Magneton
description: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

name: Psyduck
description: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

name: Noivern
description: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

name: Sigilyph
description: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

name: Flareon
description: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Gourgeist
description: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Raichu
description: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Chinchou
description: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

name: Lugia
description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Magneton
description: The Magnemite are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

name: Lucario
description: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

name: Honedge
description: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

name: Gyarados
description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Stoutland
description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

name: Rhydon
description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Snover
description: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.

name: Torchic
description: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

name: Electrike
description: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Charjabug
description: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, ______ strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

name: Salandit
description: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

name: Pupitar
description: Its body is hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

name: Zoroark
description: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Liepard
description: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

name: Bisharp
description: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

name: Celebi
description: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

name: Aegislash
description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: Abomasnow
description: This Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

name: Kricketot
description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Unown
description: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Rockruff
description: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

name: Primeape
description: Some researchers theorize that ______ remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

name: Wartortle
description: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

name: Salazzle
description: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: Snorlax
description: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Magmar
description: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

name: Roggenrola
description: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

name: Honedge
description: ______'s soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up ______'s body.

name: Riolu
description: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

name: Finneon
description: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.

name: Forretress
description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Timburr
description: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

name: Lickitung
description: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

name: Pawniard
description: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

name: Flabébé
description: ______ wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

name: Alakazam
description: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

name: Spearow
description: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

name: Krokorok
description: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

name: Bellsprout
description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Ariados
description: It wanders in search of food after darkness falls, never nesting in a specific place.

name: Raichu
description: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Golett
description: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.

name: Goodra
description: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.

name: Combusken
description: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

name: Haunter
description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Scolipede
description: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Gumshoos
description: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

name: Landorus
description: Lands visited by ______ grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Happiny
description: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

name: Jangmo-o
description: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where ______ lives.

name: Lickitung
description: Bug Pokémon are ______'s main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

name: Bellossom
description: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

name: Gimmighoul
description: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Charizard
description: It is said that ______'s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

name: Wormadam
description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Clefairy
description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of ______ dancing under a full moon.

name: Haunter
description: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

name: Mankey
description: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

name: Slurpuff
description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Mow Rotom
description: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

name: Ponyta
description: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

name: Scraggy
description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Swablu
description: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

name: Nuzleaf
description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Hoothoot
description: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

name: Enamorus
description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Graveler
description: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

name: Indeedee
description: In search of happy feelings—such as joy and gratitude—______ bustles around, taking diligent care of people and other Pokémon.

name: Pelipper
description: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

name: Volbeat
description: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE's sweet aroma.

name: Gible
description: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Nincada
description: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

name: Treecko
description: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Toxtricity
description: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

name: Metang
description: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting ______ has doubled psychic powers.

name: Carvanha
description: They can swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

name: Noibat
description: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

name: Falinks
description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Meowth
description: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Gorebyss
description: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

name: Karrablast
description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Morelull
description: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on ______'s head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Walrein
description: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.

name: Excadrill
description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Numel
description: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

name: Dark Gengar
description: It absorbs the heat in the air around it. If you suddenly feel cold, it's because a Gengar has appeared.

name: Drowzee
description: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

name: Dark Crobat
description: Although the wings it has evolved on its feet allow it to fly at high speeds, they unfortunately make it difficult to perch.

name: Voltorb
description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Jigglypuff
description: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

name: Pikachu
description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Sableye
description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Beedrill
description: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

name: Gossifleur
description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Zekrom
description: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Woobat
description: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a ______ has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

name: Cloyster
description: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.

name: Kirlia
description: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Venonat
description: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Light Ledian
description: The number of spots on its back increase or decrease depending on the number of stars visible in the night sky.

name: Paras
description: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Blitzle
description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Veluza
description: When ______ discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

name: Lugia
description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Phantump
description: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Yamask
description: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

name: Kricketot
description: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

name: Probopass
description: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

name: Raticate
description: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

name: Reshiram
description: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Terapagos
description: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to ______.

name: Natu
description: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

name: Alolan Vulpix
description: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

name: Alomomola
description: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Caterpie
description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Weavile
description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Metagross
description: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.

name: Horsea
description: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

name: Snorlax
description: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Munchlax
description: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.

name: Litten
description: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Victini
description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Mightyena
description: Thanks to Mightyena's outstanding leadership, it's very good at combination attacks that can leave a foe helpless.

name: Piplup
description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Pachirisu
description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Hitmontop
description: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

name: Slaking
description: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Numel
description: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

name: Sandygast
description: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become ______.

name: Bouffalant
description: They are known to charge so wildly that if a train were to enter their territory, they would send it flying.

name: Charmeleon
description: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Claydol
description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Exeggutor
description: Each of ______'s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Helioptile
description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Aegislash
description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: Rhyhorn
description: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

name: Foongus
description: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: Morgrem
description: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Fearow
description: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

name: Aerodactyl
description: ______'s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

name: Gothitelle
description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Rhyhorn
description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

name: Salamence
description: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

name: Horsea
description: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Flamigo
description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Skitty
description: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Wooper
description: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It leaves the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Tangrowth
description: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

name: Mamoswine
